story.vex: That free star-chart app you installed? We wrote it. Enjoy the view — we already have yours. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The tracker is silenced and its exit sealed. Astro: "Free things cost something. This time it almost cost us our position."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Something on this machine keeps phoning home. Check what's listening and what's running, find the tracker, and shut it down for good.

1. netstat -an
2. tasklist
3. taskkill /im starchart-free.exe /f

steps.title: Find what's phoning home
steps.body: Volt: "Something is sending our position out. Find it." Run `netstat -an` to see what's listening, and `tasklist` to see what's running. One process doesn't belong.

objectives.label: Its outbound port (8891) no longer listens
